mapper.select:
SELECT A.ID_LOG_SEQ AS idLogSeq, A.USER_ID AS userId, A.USE_YN AS useYn, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT LEFT(B.SERVICECD, 1) ORDER BY B.SERVICECD SEPARATOR ',') AS groupCd, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT LEFT(B.SERVICECD, 3) ORDER BY B.SERVICECD SEPARATOR ',') AS serviceCd, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT B.SERVICENM_LV1 ORDER BY B.SERVICECD SEPARATOR ',') AS groupNm, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT B.SERVICENM_LV2 ORDER BY B.SERVICECD SEPARATOR ',') AS serviceNm, DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATE_DT,'%Y-%m-%d %T') AS createDt, (SELECT X.ADMIN_NAME FROM UI_ADMIN X WHERE X.ADMIN_ID = A.CREATE_USER LIMIT 1) AS createId, DATE_FORMAT(A.UPDATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS updateDt, (SELECT X.ADMIN_NAME FROM UI_ADMIN X WHERE X.ADMIN_ID = A.UPDATE_ID LIMIT 1) AS updateId FROM UI_ID_NOLOG A LEFT JOIN UI_SERVICE B ON FIND_IN_SET(LEFT(B.SERVICECD, 3), A.SERVICECD) WHERE 1=1
AND A.USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%')
AND FIND_IN_SET(#{serviceCd}, A.SERVICECD)
GROUP BY A.ID_LOG_SEQ, A.USER_ID, A.USE_YN, A.CREATE_DT, A.CREATE_USER, A.UPDATE_DT, A.UPDATE_ID ORDER BY A.ID_LOG_SEQ DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UI_ID_NOLOG ( ID_LOG_SEQ, SERVICECD, USER_ID, CREATE_DT, USE_YN, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_DT ) SELECT IFNULL(MAX(CAST(ID_LOG_SEQ AS UNSIGNED)),0)+1, #{serviceCd}, #{userId}, NOW(), 'Y', #{createId}, now() FROM UI_ID_NOLOG
mapper.update: UPDATE UI_DEVICE SET RULE_VERSION = IFNULL(RULE_VERSION,0)+1, RULE_DATE = NOW() WHERE DEVICE_SEQ = #{deviceSeq}
mapper.select:
SELECT B.deviceName AS deviceNm, B.deviceSeq AS deviceSeq, A.USE_YN AS useYn, A.IP_LOG_SEQ AS ipLogSeq, A.USER_IP_ALL AS userIpAll, A.SERVER_IP_ALL AS serverIpAll, A.COMMENT AS comment, A.USER_PORT_ALL AS userPortAll, USER_S_PORT AS userSPort, USER_E_PORT AS userEPort, A.SERVER_PORT_ALL AS serverPortAll, SERVER_S_PORT AS serverSPort, SERVER_E_PORT AS serverEPort, DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATE_DT,'%Y-%m-%d %T') AS createDt, (SELECT X.ADMIN_NAME FROM UI_ADMIN X WHERE X.ADMIN_ID = A.CREATE_USER LIMIT 1) AS createId, DATE_FORMAT(A.UPDATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %T' ) AS updateDt, (SELECT X.ADMIN_NAME FROM UI_ADMIN X WHERE X.ADMIN_ID = A.UPDATE_ID LIMIT 1) AS updateId, USER_S_IP AS userSIp, USER_E_IP AS userEIp, SERVER_S_IP AS serverSIp, SERVER_E_IP AS serverEIp, CASE WHEN A.USER_IP_ALL = 'Y' THEN 'All' ELSE CONCAT(USER_S_IP, ' ~ ', USER_E_IP) END AS userIpDesc, CASE WHEN A.SERVER_IP_ALL = 'Y' THEN 'All' ELSE CONCAT(SERVER_S_IP, ' ~ ', SERVER_E_IP) END AS serverIpDesc, CASE WHEN A.USER_PORT_ALL = 'Y' THEN 'All' ELSE CONCAT(USER_S_PORT, ' ~ ', USER_E_PORT) END AS userPortDesc, CASE WHEN A.SERVER_PORT_ALL = 'Y' THEN 'All' ELSE CONCAT(SERVER_S_PORT, ' ~ ', SERVER_E_PORT) END AS serverPortDesc FROM UI_IP_NOLOG A LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT C.IP_LOG_SEQ, GROUP_CONCAT( B.DEVICE_NM ORDER BY B.DEVICE_NM SEPARATOR ', ' ) AS deviceName, GROUP_CONCAT( B.DEVICE_SEQ ORDER BY B.DEVICE_NM SEPARATOR ', ' ) AS deviceSeq FROM UI_DEVICE B, UI_IP_NOLOG_DEVICE C WHERE B.DEVICE_SEQ = C.DEVICE_SEQ GROUP BY C.IP_LOG_SEQ ) AS B ON A.IP_LOG_SEQ = B.IP_LOG_SEQ WHERE 1=1
AND (( USER_S_IP LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr},'%') OR USER_E_IP LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr},'%') OR SERVER_S_IP LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr},'%') OR SERVER_E_IP LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr},'%') ))
ORDER BY A.IP_LOG_SEQ DESC

SELECT A.DEVICE_SEQ AS deviceSeq, A.IP_LOG_SEQ AS ipLogSeq, A.VERSION AS `version`, DATE_FORMAT(A.RUTIME,'%Y-%m-%d %T') AS rutime, B.DEVICE_NM AS deviceName FROM UI_IP_NOLOG_DEVICE A, UI_DEVICE B WHERE A.DEVICE_SEQ = B.DEVICE_SEQ AND A.IP_LOG_SEQ = #{ipLogSeq}
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(IP_LOG_SEQ),0)+1 AS ipLogSeq FROM UI_IP_NOLOG
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UI_IP_NOLOG ( IP_LOG_SEQ, USER_IP_ALL, USER_S_IP, USER_E_IP, USER_PORT_ALL, USER_S_PORT, USER_E_PORT, SERVER_IP_ALL, SERVER_S_IP, SERVER_E_IP, SERVER_PORT_ALL, SERVER_S_PORT, SERVER_E_PORT, COMMENT, CREATE_DT, USE_YN, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_DT ) VALUES ( #{ipLogSeq}, #{userIpAll}, #{userSIp}, #{userEIp}, #{userPortAll}, #{userSPort}, #{userEPort}, #{serverIpAll}, #{serverSIp}, #{serverEIp}, #{serverPortAll}, #{serverSPort}, #{serverEPort}, #{comment}, NOW(), #{useYn}, #{createId}, now() )
INSERT INTO UI_IP_NOLOG_DEVICE ( DEVICE_SEQ, IP_LOG_SEQ, VERSION, RUTIME ) VALUES ( #{deviceSeq}, #{ipLogSeq}, '1', NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE UI_IP_NOLOG SET USER_IP_ALL = #{userIpAll}, USER_S_IP = #{userSIp}, USER_E_IP = #{userEIp}, USER_PORT_ALL = #{userPortAll}, USER_S_PORT = #{userSPort}, USER_E_PORT = #{userEPort}, SERVER_IP_ALL = #{serverIpAll}, SERVER_S_IP = #{serverSIp}, SERVER_E_IP = #{serverEIp}, SERVER_PORT_ALL = #{serverPortAll}, SERVER_S_PORT = #{serverSPort}, SERVER_E_PORT = #{serverEPort}, COMMENT = #{comment}, UPDATE_DT = NOW(), UPDATE_ID = #{updateId} WHERE IP_LOG_SEQ = #{ipLogSeq}
mapper.delete: DELETE UI_IP_NOLOG FROM UI_IP_NOLOG WHERE IP_LOG_SEQ = #{ipLogSeq}

SELECT DISTINCT A.DOMAIN_LOG_SEQ AS domainLogSeq, A.DOMAIN AS domain, A.USE_YN AS useYn, LEFT(B.SERVICECD, 1) AS groupCd, LEFT(B.SERVICECD, 3) AS serviceCd, B.SERVICENM_LV1 AS groupNm, B.SERVICENM_LV2 AS serviceNm, DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATE_DT,'%Y-%m-%d %T') AS createDt, (SELECT X.ADMIN_NAME FROM UI_ADMIN X WHERE X.ADMIN_ID = A.CREATE_USER LIMIT 1) AS createId, DATE_FORMAT(A.UPDATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %T' ) AS updateDt, (SELECT X.ADMIN_NAME FROM UI_ADMIN X WHERE X.ADMIN_ID = A.UPDATE_ID LIMIT 1) AS updateId FROM UI_DOMAIN_NOLOG A, UI_SERVICE B WHERE A.SERVICECD = LEFT(B.SERVICECD, 3)
AND A.DOMAIN LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%')
AND A.SERVICECD = #{serviceCd}
ORDER BY A.DOMAIN_LOG_SEQ DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UI_DOMAIN_NOLOG ( DOMAIN_LOG_SEQ, SERVICECD, DOMAIN, CREATE_DT, USE_YN, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_DT ) SELECT IFNULL(MAX(CAST(DOMAIN_LOG_SEQ AS UNSIGNED)),0)+1, #{serviceCd}, #{domain}, NOW(), 'Y', #{createId}, now() FROM UI_DOMAIN_NOLOG
mapper.select:
SELECT A.URL_LOG_SEQ AS urlLogSeq, A.URL AS url, A.USE_YN AS useYn, DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATE_DT,'%Y-%m-%d %T') AS createDt, (SELECT X.ADMIN_NAME FROM UI_ADMIN X WHERE X.ADMIN_ID = A.CREATE_USER LIMIT 1) AS createId, DATE_FORMAT(A.UPDATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %T' ) AS updateDt, (SELECT X.ADMIN_NAME FROM UI_ADMIN X WHERE X.ADMIN_ID = A.UPDATE_ID LIMIT 1) AS updateId FROM UI_URL_NOLOG A WHERE 1 = 1
AND A.URL LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%')
ORDER BY A.URL_LOG_SEQ DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UI_URL_NOLOG ( URL_LOG_SEQ, URL, CREATE_DT, USE_YN, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_DT ) SELECT IFNULL(MAX(CAST(URL_LOG_SEQ AS UNSIGNED)),0)+1, #{url}, NOW(), 'Y', #{createId}, now() FROM UI_URL_NOLOG

SELECT DISTINCT A.SUBJECT_LOG_SEQ AS subjectLogSeq, A.SUBJECT AS subject, A.USE_YN AS useYn, LEFT(B.SERVICECD, 1) AS groupCd, LEFT(B.SERVICECD, 3) AS serviceCd, B.SERVICENM_LV1 AS groupNm, B.SERVICENM_LV2 AS serviceNm, DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATE_DT,'%Y-%m-%d %T') AS createDt, (SELECT X.ADMIN_NAME FROM UI_ADMIN X WHERE X.ADMIN_ID = A.CREATE_USER LIMIT 1) AS createId, DATE_FORMAT(A.UPDATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %T' ) AS updateDt, (SELECT X.ADMIN_NAME FROM UI_ADMIN X WHERE X.ADMIN_ID = A.UPDATE_ID LIMIT 1) AS updateId FROM UI_SUBJECT_NOLOG A, UI_SERVICE B WHERE A.SERVICECD = LEFT(B.SERVICECD, 3)
AND A.SUBJECT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%')
AND A.SERVICECD = #{serviceCd}
ORDER BY A.SUBJECT_LOG_SEQ DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UI_SUBJECT_NOLOG ( SUBJECT_LOG_SEQ, SERVICECD, SUBJECT, CREATE_DT, USE_YN, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_DT ) SELECT IFNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBJECT_LOG_SEQ AS UNSIGNED)),0)+1, #{serviceCd}, #{subject}, NOW(), 'Y', #{createId}, now() FROM UI_SUBJECT_NOLOG

SELECT DISTINCT A.SIZE_LOG_SEQ AS sizeLogSeq, A.LOWSIZE AS lowSize, A.HIGHSIZE AS highSize, A.SIZE_CONDITION AS sizeCondition, A.USE_YN AS useYn, LEFT(B.SERVICECD, 1) AS groupCd, LEFT(B.SERVICECD, 3) AS serviceCd, B.SERVICENM_LV1 AS groupNm, B.SERVICENM_LV2 AS serviceNm, DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATE_DT,'%Y-%m-%d %T') AS createDt, (SELECT X.ADMIN_NAME FROM UI_ADMIN X WHERE X.ADMIN_ID = A.CREATE_USER LIMIT 1) AS createId, DATE_FORMAT(A.UPDATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %T' ) AS updateDt, (SELECT X.ADMIN_NAME FROM UI_ADMIN X WHERE X.ADMIN_ID = A.UPDATE_ID LIMIT 1) AS updateId FROM UI_SIZE_LOG A, UI_SERVICE B WHERE A.SERVICECD = LEFT(B.SERVICECD, 3)
AND A.SUBJECT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%')
AND A.SERVICECD = #{serviceCd}
ORDER BY A.SIZE_LOG_SEQ DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UI_SIZE_LOG (SIZE_LOG_SEQ, SERVICECD, LOWSIZE, HIGHSIZE, SIZE_CONDITION, CREATE_DT, USE_YN, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_DT) SELECT IFNULL(MAX(CAST(SIZE_LOG_SEQ AS UNSIGNED)),0)+1, #{serviceCd}, CAST(#{lowSize} AS UNSIGNED), CAST(CASE #{highSize} WHEN '' THEN '0' ELSE #{highSize} END AS UNSIGNED), #{sizeCondition}, NOW(), 'Y', #{createId}, now() FROM UI_SIZE_LOG
mapper.update: UPDATE UI_SIZE_LOG SET LOWSIZE = #{lowSize}, HIGHSIZE = #{highSize}, SIZE_CONDITION = #{sizeCondition}, UPDATE_DT = NOW(), UPDATE_ID = #{updateId} WHERE SIZE_LOG_SEQ = #{sizeLogSeq}

SELECT IFNULL(C.RULE_VERSION,0)+1 AS ruleVersion, '6' AS protocol, '2' AS action, USER_S_IP AS userSIp, USER_E_IP AS userEIp, USER_S_PORT AS userSPort, USER_E_PORT AS userEPort, SERVER_S_IP AS serverSIp, SERVER_E_IP AS serverEIp, SERVER_S_PORT AS serverSPort, SERVER_E_PORT AS serverEPort FROM UI_IP_NOLOG A, UI_IP_NOLOG_DEVICE B, UI_DEVICE C WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.IP_LOG_SEQ = B.IP_LOG_SEQ AND B.DEVICE_SEQ = #{deviceSeq} AND B.DEVICE_SEQ = C.DEVICE_SEQ ORDER BY A.IP_LOG_SEQ

SELECT DEVICE_SEQ AS deviceSeq, DEVICE_IP AS code, DEVICE_NM AS codeName FROM UI_DEVICE WHERE 1 = 1
AND DEVICE_SEQ IN (${deviceSeq})
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY codeName

SELECT USER_S_IP, USER_E_IP, SERVER_S_IP, SERVER_E_IP FROM UI_IP_NOLOG WHERE USE_YN = 'Y'
AND IP_LOG_SEQ != #{ipLogSeq}

SELECT A.PATTERN_LOG_SEQ AS patternLogSeq, A.PRIVATETYPE AS privateType, A.PATTERN AS pattern, A.USE_YN AS useYn, DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATE_DT,'%Y-%m-%d %T') AS createDt, A.CREATE_USER AS createUser FROM UI_PATTERN_EXCEPT A WHERE 1 = 1
AND A.PATTERN LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%')
AND A.PRIVATETYPE LIKE CONCAT(#{privateType})
